name: Ubai ~Hito no Onna, Urimasu~
source:
The protagonist Iijima Ryousuke is affiliated with a small pornography studio called "Ubai", and works as an actor, cameraman, and other miscellaneous jobs. Ubai's theme is normally about netori and netorare, which is the center of the photos and videos they shoot. 

However, beneath their pornography production, Ubai also illegally markets prostitutes to members exclusively which is also themed around netori. Now, women with various financial problems seeking to solve it came to Ubai. Ryousuke's job under the official Ubai is to film their promotional videos and sell their bodies to customers and train these women as well, if needed. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.ubai.org/ubai/ubai_story.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
主角饭岛亮介供职于一家名为“夺取”的小型色情工作室，担任演员、摄影师及其他杂务人员。“夺取”的主题通常是寝取和被寝取，这也是他们拍摄照片和视频的核心。

然而，在色情制作背后，“夺取”还非法向会员销售妓女，同样以寝取为主题。如今，许多有经济问题、希望解决困境的女性来到“夺取”。亮介在“夺取”名义下的工作，是拍摄她们的宣传视频，把她们的身体卖给顾客，并在需要时训练这些女性。
